episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Daniel's absence at the cattle station triggers hostility in the Lawson family. Graham tries to take the reins, and Emily seeks comfort elsewhere.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Graham runs for federation president and seeks Colin's support — but the pressure pushes him to drink. Emily turns to Hank for help finding Marshall.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Nolan is caught in a rift with the Indigenous community. Sandra proposes deals, and a risky job drives a wedge between Marshall and Rich.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The discovery of Daniel's saddle sparks new questions as Graham unravels. Marshall and Sharnie find solace in each other. Susie forges her own path.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Amid an uneasy truce, the Lawson family takes on an immense cattle muster. But sabotage — and tragedy — lead to devastating uncertainty.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Emily debates her future at Marianne Station. Lachie makes an explosive revelation about Sandra's motives, leading to a dangerous shootout.
